summary.text: Amelia Wiederaenders is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 30 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Laura Williams (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked on political campaigns and community advocacy for more than 16 years and named affordability, reproductive rights and education as her key messages.

paragraphs.text: Wiederaenders graduated from Shawnee Mission East High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2009 and a graduate degree from the University of San Francisco in 2019, according to Ballotpedia; it lists her profession as political organizer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she lived in San Francisco from 2013 to 2019 and has spent the past seven years as a caregiver for her 103-year-old grandmother.
Wiederaenders won the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary with 936 votes, ahead of Tyler Holmes and Zachary Hawkins.
In the same survey, Wiederaenders said she also supports investments in public transportation and affordable care for children, seniors and vulnerable loved ones.
